Shot Spotter

By: Liz Fish | Delivery

Proposal


Show:

One Liner (Tonight on Carte Blanche...):
High Tech solution to gang violence on the Cape Flats

Summary:
Shot Spotter is a high tech acoustic sensor enabling the City of Cape Town to significantly bring down the number of shooting incidents in the ganglands of Hanover Park and Manenberg. Microphones are located in a 1 km radius in various locations in Hanover Park and Manenberg and when a shot is fired the audio frequency is sent to California, and within 30 to 40 seconds an SMS with the exact number of shots and the GPS co-ordinates of the shot is sent to the Metro Police control centre. Police can be despatched within minutes. Depending on the number of shots and the frequency of shots it also assists Metro in deciding on the number of law enforcement officers to despatch. It has dramatically curbed the escalation of violence.

Further information:
The use of the app has been piloted over the last two years in Cape Town with a dedicated focus over the last six months - 57 guns have been confiscated in just five months, a figure that used to be achieved over a six year period; 2 500 gun shots were recorded in six months and 2000 arrests made - in the past that figure was closer to 380 arrests. In Hanover Park in June there were 86 incidents and by September that figure had come down to 33. In Manenberg, 133 incidents came down to 22. Over the Christmas period between the 19-25th December only 5 shots in total in both areas.
Shot Spotter was developed in America to assist communities crippled by crime. When Cape Town Mayco member for security JP Smith visited the States he was introduced to Shot Spotter and spent several years trying to bring it to SA. It costs about R5 million per location, giving the City tools to begin to effectively analyse and combat gangs in the area, and they now have evidence that can be used in court cases. In the past gang members fire numerous rounds and then disappear. When chased they simply dump the guns over a wall or pass them onto younger gang members who move the guns.
Shot Spotter has given the City accurate data on exact locations with regard to the frequency of shots, time of day and days when the shooting occurs. They have been sharing this data with the Ceasefire Project in Hanover Park, another programme initiated in the States. Ceasefire is an NGO that works with former gang members or people who have lost family members to gang violence. They work closely within the community to divert conflict before it starts. The data from Shot Spotter has helped them deal with conflict areas more effectively.
Taswell Johnson is a volunteer with Ceasefire working in the conflict areas in Hanover Park- he lost his two best friends to gun violence in Hanover Park and is willing to take us through the area.

Press Release:


Farmers Update
The new year is already delivering good news: rain has fallen in many drought-stricken areas and healthy crops are returning the smiles to the faces of desperate farmers. In 2016 Oom Jim Botha and Michris Janse Van Rensburg’s livelihoods were devastated by the drought. But, it seems things are looking up. Carte Blanche revisits the farmers whose desperate prayers for rain seem to have brought back the water, crops and herds.


Script:


Anthea “He was always the quiet one it makes me sad they just come and shoot the people it is not right it’s not right
Script: 7 months ago Anthea Smith's 15 year old son Keegan was walking to the shops and was killed in a drive-by shooting. He was a rising soccer star and had nothing to do with the gangs
Anthea “There is a lot of young children here they are playing soccer they sit here they are playing games and they play a lot there in the court and the people just come here and they shoot
Freda Appolis “My neighbour come and she knock on the door and said your son is lying there is a pool of blood, when I got there he was dead already
Script: Freda’s son Eric was shot 4 times in the head. He was a former Durban Kids gang member.
Freda Appolis “Every night there was a shooting business the gangs even run right through the court to go an shoot there in the passageway.
Script: Since his death the shooting has escalated into a gang turf war in the notoriously violent suburb of Hanover Park on the Cape Flats.
JP “Over 8 or 9 months we recorded 2800 shooting incidents, madness they could not believe how many shooting incidents they were seeing because by American standards that is outrageous
Links: “There was a call not that long ago for the military to be deployed to help stem gansterism on the Cape Flats but it is technology that is proving to be the best and most efficient means of taking the fight to the gangsters
JP “There are 4 such shooting incidents in the last half day
Script: The City of Cape Town Safety and Security councillor JP Smith has introduced a smart policing tool called Shot Spotter after seeing it in action in Washington DC. Hanover Park and Manenberg are the two suburbs where audio sensors were positioned in a square kilometre array and every time a shot is fired it sets off an alarm in the Metro control centre
JP “CCTV cameras look at crime…Shot Spotter listens to crime. So every time there is a gunshot the system triangulates that gunshot accurate to within few meters, drops a pin on a map, tells you if it is a single or multiple gunshot and allows you to listen to the audio recording so you can hear what calibre. Is it multiple shooters, are they mobile, and then allows you to dispatch your resources to go an intercept that
Up sound “re-enactment of dispatching of law enforcement
Script: Since Shot spotter was introduced 6 months ago the shooting incidence has dropped dramatically. 54 guns have been removed in 7 months, a figure that used to be achieved over a six year period. Shot Spotter has enabled them to use their limited resources in a smart way says Senior Superintendent Kesevan Chetty
Sup Chetty “Its very important to have officers on the ground that know the area but what is so good about the information is that the information is accurate in that the officer knows exactly where to go to because control will dispatch him and control also has eyes on the officer because we integrate CCTV together with Shot spotter so that they eyes are on the officer and should there be any danger that the officer would encounter he can be alerted by CCTV
JP “The officers also gets the alert on their personal devices which also gives them a link to audio file
Script: The response time of law enforcement has been brought down from an hour to 10 minutes. Being on the scene quickly gives them a far greater chance of finding the suspects, interviewing witnesses and gathering evidence that will stand up in court.
Sup Chetty “In the last two weeks we have noticed a peak ….Shot spotter has actually spoken to us and told us there has been an increase there has been a peak . So what we do now is go an determine why is there a peak and we use the forces that we have and the specialised units that we have like the GDT
Script: GDT- the Gang and Drug Task team now has access to addition crime intelligence. It can analyse the hot spots through heat maps, look at trends of when the shooting happens, for example Hanover Park shootings happen mostly on Saturdays between 9pm and 11 pm, but Manenberg on Sunday between 11 and 3am,
JP “ From July till now - 918 incidents including 2199 rounds and if you start analysing that there is a pattern we started working really hard in the area and we drove down these stats
Sup Chetty “So often what happens in a scenario like you are seeing right now is that we would receive information via Shot spotter and sit an determine where the shots are currently coming from and this is how we would operationise. So we would come in an area and do random stop and searches and increase visibility and police presence in this area to basically deter any kind of criminal activity
John: What are they fighting about?
“Turf mostly turf “
Officer in car: naming all the different gangs as we drive around
Link: Here in Hanover Park as in other parts of the Cape Flats the gangs are in very close proximity almost in each other’s shadows and they often fire at each other across open spaces like this one and as a result they become very dangerous places to be
Officer “Some gangs know about this technology that’s taking place with shot spotter but they don’t care about it , they really don’t care they just go on with it.
JP “The next thing is to link our drones to it. You can start manually getting the drones to respond let them finish shooting and then follow them home. There are drones that have the ability to be airborne for several hours. We will be able to get automated response from the drone where it will automatically take off and it goes and records the footage
Link: “There is another layer as to how the gang conflict is being dealt with the shot spotter technology is being used by the Ceasefire NGO in a unique and very different way.
Script: Ceasefire aims is to diffuse gang violence before it happens, using what they call Interrupters explains Pastor Craven Engel
Craven “Well an interrupter is a credible messenger that used to be involved in gang violence used to be in prison maybe he has got the number system he has gone through that process, he has changed his life we have taken him into our program we train him for about two years
Script. Funded by the City of Cape Town, Ceasefire creates alternative sources of employment and diversion programs for gangsters. Because there are so many different factions, interrupters can only work in their specific area where they have credibility with that gang.
Craven “They would also look at the shooter look at who is most likely to become the shooter, and make it his job to get to those guys as well. He does a lot of prevention work but his main job is to interrupt an actual shooting or retaliation taking place and if he cannot do that his job is to get the groups to start talking before they shoot again. But he has got no armour he has got no weapons on him he has only got his track suit and if he is not credible with the gangs and with the community and with the street gangs he can be dead
Teshwill “If they have revenge on their minds then they take a gun and shoot a Mongrel. That’s the reason I took a gun and shot them too.
Script Teshwill Johnson a former 27 Gang member claims he has killed so many people he has lost count. He’s been a volunteer interrupter for Ceasefire for the last two years.
Teshwill “ The reason I made a change in my life is because of the Mongrel friends that I lost, people that I made Mongrels that have been shot. Just there I said to myself- make a change in your life before your whole family is killed.
Craven “Shot spotter has made a significant difference with regards to us tracking violence, I have got interrupters in 9 pockets of HP so my interrupters used to hear by ear where a shot was fired…so sometimes you get to the wrong area and then you are losing 5-10 minutes and that is bad to get to a scene because you want to stop retaliation.
Script: Ceasefire is also using it’s own mobile app called Investigator in conjunction with Shot Spotter. It tracks the Interrupters movements through GPS, and allows for real time recording of their interventions. This enables Ceasefire to keep track of the situation from the offices
Craven “What Shot Spotter has aided us with is to get to the right spot within two minutes we can ….we get it on our phones and we get it on our investigator …..we will know what gang is shooting what shooter is there what the reason is for the conflict so he is not going to go in blind so the shot spotter actually keeps our guys quite safe. 01 19 51 23…. the community obviously is encouraged they are very traumatised when a shot is fired if a community see a law enforcement see an officer within 7 minutes on the scene and most of the times in recent months the guy has been running into law enforcement
Link: “One of the benefits of the shot spotter technology is that it has almost forced the gangsters to fire single shots as opposed to volleys of bullets in running battles and as a result of that fewer people including children are being caught in the crossfire
John: Has the investment been worth it
JP: Absolutely and if I had more budget I would roll it out in other areas
Craven “I think technology, feet on the ground, community mobilization public education it’s become a great game changer, for Hanover Park
Script: It is clear that the shot spotter technology is assisting both Ceasefire and Law Enforcement, but this battle is far from over
Anthea “They must get their sentence it is not fair. They are walking up and down and they think they are Kwai, they Kwai it’s not fair
Freda Appolis “I would like to see the boys who have got guns must be thrown in jail because they just shoot anybody and they don’t care
